title: Changes inside Barber's program after the 2017 New York Times article

tellings.quote: When the New York Times article came out like 2017, uh it was really about then things started getting really weird for us

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a recovered UFO, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he worked inside a secret programme. He says that when a 2017 New York Times article about Pentagon UFO work came out, things started getting really weird for his team, suggesting the article shook up those keeping the secrets.
